source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

china_plus_one.evidence: Royal Enfield exports surged 29.7% YoY to 100,136 units in FY2025 (10% of total volumes of 1,002,893 units), with CKD operations launched in Thailand and Brazil planned. Exports span 60+ countries. However, no explicit China+1 or supply-chain-diversification narrative found in available press releases — RE is positioned as an aspirational lifestyle brand in emerging/developed markets rather than a beneficiary of global manufacturing re-shoring.

inr_exposure.evidence: Royal Enfield exported 100,136 units in FY2025, representing ~10% of total volumes. Revenue contribution from exports estimated ~12% of Royal Enfield segment revenue (total FY2025 consolidated revenue ~₹18,870 Cr). VECV (51% JV with Volvo AB) contributes majority of Eicher consolidated revenue and is almost 100% domestic.

china_plus_one.evidence: Analyst coverage and investor presentations explicitly note Navin Fluorine benefits from rising preference for Indian fluorochemical suppliers amid China+1 sentiment. India is positioned as the primary alternative to China for specialty fluorochemicals used in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and advanced materials (e.g., Opteon for data-centre immersion cooling). CDMO business (HPP ~₹12Bn, Specialty ~₹8Bn, CDMO ~₹8Bn in FY25 per HDFC Sec deep-dive) growing at 33% CAGR through long-term supply agreements with global innovators diversifying away from Chinese CDMO suppliers. Q4FY25 data: 77% of revenue from exports, 23% domestic.

crude_exposure.evidence: Navin Fluorine's specialty and CDMO segments use organic fluorochemical synthesis that requires petroleum-derived organic intermediates. HPP segment uses HF (from fluorspar — not crude-linked). Estimated ~20% of total raw material costs are crude oil-linked (organic fluorine intermediates, solvents for CDMO/Specialty). Revenue segments FY25: HPP ~INR 12Bn, Specialty ~INR 8Bn, CDMO ~INR 8Bn.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts and options on export receivables; typical treasury practice for specialty chemical exporters
inr_exposure.evidence: Q4FY25: 77% revenue from exports, 23% domestic. Major customers are global agrochemical and pharmaceutical companies in US, Europe, Japan. Revenue largely USD/EUR-denominated. Company reports hedging through forward contracts per analyst coverage.

rural.evidence: Varun Beverages operates across India including semi-urban and rural distribution network as a PepsiCo bottling franchise. Distribution extends into tier 3/4 cities and rural areas particularly for affordable PET/glass SKUs. Rural/semi-urban estimated at ~30% of India revenue based on product mix and distribution territory coverage across rural India.

crude_exposure.evidence: PET resin (polyethylene terephthalate, derived from petroleum via PTA and MEG) is the primary packaging raw material for VBL's beverage operations. PET resin costs typically constitute ~30-40% of raw material cost for beverage bottlers. FY2025 consolidated net revenue: ₹21,690 Cr (₹216.9Bn, up 8.4% YoY). Crude oil price fluctuations directly impact PET resin pricing and thus Varun Beverages' margins.

inr_exposure.evidence: International revenue (~30% of total FY2025, primarily Africa) is in local African currencies (ZAR, ZMW, ZWL, MAD, etc.) — not USD. South Africa (post-BevCo acquisition), Zimbabwe, Zambia, Morocco, DRC are the main African territories. Nepal and Sri Lanka contribute smaller South Asian (~5%) international revenue. Currency translation risk from African currencies to INR is the key exposure; USD hedging is not the primary tool.

china_plus_one.evidence: Pidilite operates in ~70 countries with manufacturing subsidiaries in UAE, Thailand, Brazil, Egypt, and USA. International subsidiaries (excl. USA/Brazil) grew double-digits in FY2025 despite global uncertainty. However, no explicit China+1 supply-chain diversification narrative found — Pidilite's international expansion is brand-led (Fevicol, Dr. Fixit) not supply-chain-driven.

crude_exposure.evidence: Pidilite's primary raw materials include Vinyl Acetate Monomer (VAM — derived from ethylene from petroleum/naphtha) for its adhesives range, and various petrochemical derivatives for construction chemicals. VAM and petroleum-derived monomers constitute an estimated ~40% of raw material costs. FY2025 revenue: ₹13,400 Cr. Consumer & Bazaar segment (>80% of consolidated revenue) uses VAM-based formulations (Fevicol, Fevikwik, M-Seal, Dr. Fixit).

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts on export receivables (industry standard practice for international subsidiaries)
inr_exposure.evidence: Pidilite international operations contribute ~17% of consolidated revenue (India >80%). Manufacturing presence in USA, Thailand, Dubai, Brazil, Egypt. International subsidiaries grew double-digits in FY2025. FY2025 total revenue: ₹13,400 Cr.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Nippon Life India AMC earns fee income (management fees) as % of AUM. Equity AUM (QAAUM ₹5,700Bn as of Q3FY25) benefits from rising equity markets. Rate cuts by RBI support equity market valuations, boost AUM, and thereby increase fee income. As 4th largest Indian AMC with 29% AUM growth in FY25, revenue is positively correlated with equity market performance and accommodative rate environment. Total income Q4FY25: ₹7.53Bn; 21.9 million unique investors managed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Pure domestic AMC — 100% of revenue from management fees on Indian mutual fund AUM. No export income. Record FY25 profit. 21.9 million unique investors; 15 successive quarters of market share gain.

rural.evidence: FY2025 AR theme: 'Expanding Access to Advanced Diagnostics'. Dr Lal Pathlabs has been expanding into tier 2/3 cities and rural areas through collection centres and franchised labs under its hub-and-spoke model. Revenue: ₹2,461.40 Cr FY2025; PAT: ₹492.20 Cr (PAT margin 20%). The company's national geographic expansion strategy is explicitly cited as a growth driver; estimated ~20% of revenue from non-metro/semi-urban markets.

inr_exposure.evidence: Pure domestic diagnostics company. 100% India revenue. Net Sales ₹2,461.40 Cr in FY2025, PAT ₹492.20 Cr, PAT margin 20%. No export revenue or USD exposure.

china_plus_one.evidence: Bosch India manufactures auto components for the global Bosch Group supply chain. Export sales grew within Powertrain Solutions (5.8% increase driven by 'increase in export sales') and Beyond Mobility segments in FY2025. Standalone FY2025 revenue: ₹18,087 Cr (8.1% growth); consolidated group including 14 Bosch India companies: ₹37,345.7 Cr. Bosch India's role as a global manufacturing hub for Bosch Group products (exports primarily to Europe/Germany) represents supply chain diversification consistent with China+1 dynamics, though not explicitly labeled as such in press releases.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Hedging through Bosch Group treasury management; forward contracts on intercompany export receivables to Europe
inr_exposure.evidence: Bosch India exports ~22% of revenue to Bosch Group global entities (primarily Europe). Standalone FY2025 revenue: ₹18,087 Cr. Powertrain Solutions export sales increased; two-wheeler segment grew 18.5% (predominantly domestic). Mobility Aftermarket +8.4%; Beyond Mobility +6.3%. R&D spend: ₹526 Cr; capex: ₹127 Cr.

pli_scheme.evidence: Bosch India is an auto components manufacturer and beneficiary of the PLI scheme for Automobile and Auto Components sector. The company produces powertrain components, automotive electronics, and aftermarket products eligible under PLI for auto and auto components.

china_plus_one.evidence: Garware Hi-Tech Films exports specialty performance polyester films to 90+ countries; USA is the largest revenue market. As a leading Indian specialty film manufacturer competing with Chinese and South Korean producers globally, the company benefits from customers seeking to diversify sourcing from China for specialty packaging and window/safety films. FY2025 revenue grew 25.8% to ₹2,109 Cr with EBITDA margin expanding to 20.9% from 16.8%. Export revenue was ~83% in Q3FY24 and estimated ~80% in FY2025.

crude_exposure.evidence: Garware Hi-Tech Films manufactures specialty performance polyester (PET) films. PTA (purified terephthalic acid, from petroleum naphtha) and MEG (monoethylene glycol, from ethylene from petroleum) are the primary feedstocks for PET resin. Estimated ~70% of raw material cost is crude oil-linked given the direct petroleum feedstock nature of PET film production. FY2025 PAT margin improved to 15.7% from 12.1% partly aided by lower crude-linked input costs.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts on USD export receivables; standard treasury practice for high-export specialty film company
inr_exposure.evidence: Garware Hi-Tech Films derives ~80% of revenue from exports (Q3FY24: 83%). USA is the primary export market (~35% of total revenue). Revenue from exports across 90+ countries. USD dominates export billing. FY2025 revenue: ₹2,109 Cr (25.8% growth YoY).

rural.evidence: Kajaria Ceramics operates 11 manufacturing plants and 65 offices nationally across 36 states/UTs, including tier 3/4 markets. Ceramic and vitrified tiles have significant demand in semi-urban and rural housing construction (PMAY, state housing schemes). Distribution extends to rural markets. Estimated ~25% of revenue from rural/semi-urban markets based on national plant and distribution coverage.

govt_capex.evidence: Kajaria tiles used in government housing projects (PMAY), smart cities, and government buildings. No specific government capex revenue % disclosed in available data.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports constitute 1.08% of total turnover in FY2025. Revenue: ₹4,218.82 Cr FY2025 (2.82% growth). Operates in 28 countries (very limited export presence). Ceramic/vitrified tiles (89% of turnover), faucets/sanitaryware (8%). PAT declined 46.48% YoY to ₹204.14 Cr due to margin pressure.

china_plus_one.evidence: ABB India manufactures products (Distribution Solutions, Smart Power) for export to ABB Group's global supply chain. Electrification segment had higher export revenue from Distribution Solutions and Smart Power divisions in recent quarters. ABB's growing India manufacturing footprint partly driven by global supply chain diversification. EV charging infrastructure and solar inverters growing at 25%+ (15% of revenue target by FY27 vs 8% in FY25). No explicit 'China+1' labeling in available FY2025 AR data.

govt_capex.evidence: ABB India is a major supplier to India's power sector (grid modernization, T&D infrastructure), railways (traction systems), and government-linked smart building/data infrastructure. Estimated ~40% of revenue linked to government/PSU capex in power, railways, and industrial infrastructure. Government spending in infrastructure capex noted in press releases.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts on export receivables; ABB India follows ABB Group treasury policies
inr_exposure.evidence: ABB India's export revenue (~15% of total) primarily goes to ABB Group global entities and is EUR/USD denominated. CY2025 revenue: ₹13,203 Cr (6% growth). FY2025 (Apr 2024–Mar 2025) estimated ~₹11,500–12,000 Cr. New orders in FY2025 driven by data centers, renewables, and smart infrastructure — broad-based sector demand.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Gold price hedging through MCX futures for inventory; USD forward contracts for international store revenue
inr_exposure.evidence: Titan Company FY2025 revenue: ₹57,818 Cr (22% growth). Predominantly India-domestic — jewellery (Tanishq, CaratLane), watches (Titan, Fastrack), eyewear, wearables. Jewellery drives bulk of revenue (PAT ₹3,337 Cr). International stores in Middle East and North America (diaspora-focused boutiques) contribute ~6% of revenue. 3,100+ stores in 600+ cities in India.

china_plus_one.evidence: Siemens India (fiscal year October–September) is primarily a domestic India company supplying energy, smart infrastructure, mobility, and digital solutions. Some export of engineered products to Siemens global supply chain (~15% of revenue). Q4 FY2025 (Jul–Sep 2025) revenue: ₹5,171 Cr (+16% YoY). Orders up 13% Q3 FY2025, backlog ₹42,845 Cr. No explicit China+1 narrative in available press releases.

govt_capex.evidence: Siemens India is heavily exposed to government infrastructure capex — railways (Vande Bharat trainsets, metro, traction), power grid (Smart Infrastructure), and government buildings. 'Government spending in Capex in Infrastructure continues' — explicitly noted in Siemens India press releases. Estimated ~35% of revenue from government/PSU capex-linked projects. Order backlog ₹42,845 Cr (8% growth) provides high visibility.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts; Siemens India follows Siemens Group treasury guidelines
inr_exposure.evidence: Siemens India exports ~15% of revenue to Siemens global (primarily Europe/Germany). October–September fiscal year. Q4 FY2025 revenue: ₹5,171 Cr (+16%). Mobility and Smart Infrastructure segments driving growth. Siemens Energy India (demerged entity) is separate from Siemens Limited (listed here).

FSN E-Commerce (Nykaa) is a pure-play domestic Indian e-commerce company in beauty, fashion, and wellness. Q4 FY2025 Net Revenue: ₹2,062 Cr (+24% YoY); Gross Margin 44.1%. FY2025 GMV: $1.8Bn+, cumulative customers 42M+. eB2B business (Superstore by Nykaa) serves ~260,000 transacting retailers across India. International revenue negligible. Beauty BPC segment drives majority of GMV.

Radico Khaitan derives ~91% from domestic India IMFL sales; ~9% from exports across 100+ countries. Standalone FY2025 revenue: ₹4,851 Cr (+19%). Premium export brands: Rampur Indian Single Malt Whisky, Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin, 1965 Spirit of Victory Rum. IMFL contributes 69.5% of standalone revenue (Magic Moments, 8PM, Morpheus portfolio). Export revenue USD/EUR-denominated.

china_plus_one.evidence: Sun Pharma is the 4th largest global specialty generic pharma company, present in 100+ countries. India-manufactured specialty generics and APIs are positioned as reliable alternatives to Chinese supply. US specialty (Ilumya, Levulan, Cequa) is the key growth engine. However, explicit 'China+1' framing not prominently in FY2025 press releases — growth is innovation-driven rather than supply-chain-substitution. R&D investment: ₹32,484 Mn (6.2% of sales). 542 approved ANDAs in US.

crude_exposure.evidence: Sun Pharma uses solvents, organic chemical intermediates, and API starting materials that are petroleum-derived. Estimated ~20% of raw material cost is linked to crude oil prices via petrochemical intermediates and solvents used in pharmaceutical synthesis. FY2025 consolidated R&D investment: ₹32,484 Mn (6.2% of sales).

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts and options; ~50%+ of USD receivables hedged based on industry practice for large Indian pharma exporters
inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 consolidated revenue: ~₹52,041 Cr. US formulation sales FY25: US$1,921 Mn (+3.6%, ~31% of total). India formulations: ~32% of total (+13.6% growth Q4). Emerging Markets FY25: US$1,114 Mn (+7.0%, ~18%). RoW/specialty international: ~19%. Total international/export: ~68%. Gross sales Q4FY25: ₹128,156 Mn.

pli_scheme.evidence: Sun Pharma is a beneficiary of the PLI scheme for Pharmaceuticals (bulk drugs and formulations) announced by Government of India. The company manufactures APIs and formulations covered under PLI for bulk drug parks and key starting materials for pharma.

china_plus_one.evidence: Ajanta Pharma sells branded generics across Asia (~34% of export formulations), Africa (~26% of export formulations), and US generics (~40% of export formulations). India branded business: ~35% of total. Anti-malarial now only 3% of revenue (down 41% from prior) with chronic therapies at 74%. No explicit China+1 supply-chain narrative found — Ajanta is a branded generic company focused on therapeutic segments.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts on export receivables (standard practice for pharma exporters)
inr_exposure.evidence: Ajanta Pharma FY2025 revenue: ₹4,648 Cr (+10%). International branded (Asia + Africa): ~41% of total. US generics: ~24% of total. India branded: ~35%. Export composition (% of export formulations per Q1FY26 presentation): Asia ~34%, Africa ~26%, US ~40%. Export_us_pct: 24% = 40% × 65% export share; Asia: 22% = 34% × 65%; Africa/Other: 17% = 26% × 65%.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC earns management fee income (% of AUM). QAAUM ₹4,056Bn (March 2025, +17% YoY). Equity QAAUM: ₹1,691Bn (+11% YoY). Rate cuts by RBI boost equity market valuations, expand AUM, and increase fee income. SIP book: ₹13.16Bn/month (March 2025). Revenue FY2025: ₹1,986 Cr (+21% YoY); PAT: ₹930.60 Cr (+19.25%). 10.6 million folios (+23% YoY). 543,000 new SIP registrations/month.

inr_exposure.evidence: Pure domestic Indian AMC — 100% of revenue from management fee income on Indian mutual fund AUM. No export revenue. Ranked 4th largest AMC in India. Sustained market share gains.

china_plus_one.evidence: Hitachi Energy India exports power transformers and switchgear to European utilities, Southeast Asian data centres, and Middle East renewable energy projects — markets actively diversifying procurement away from Chinese power equipment suppliers. FY2025 orders: record ₹18,173.8 Cr including HVDC orders (up 228% YoY). FY2025 revenue: ₹6,442.1 Cr (+23%); PAT up 61.8% to ₹183.9 Cr. Q4FY25 press release explicitly mentions 'notional forex exchange gains on export order delivery'. Export orders from European utilities, SE Asia data centres, Middle East renewables. Export contribution ~30% of orders (Q2FY26 data: 30.4%).

govt_capex.evidence: Hitachi Energy India's domestic business (~70% of revenue) is heavily driven by government power sector capex — Power Grid Corporation of India, state electricity boards, renewable energy transmission projects, and railways (traction transformers). Estimated ~40% of total revenue is government/PSU capex-linked. Order backlog: ₹19,245.9 Cr as of March 2025 with strong domestic T&D pipeline visibility.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts on USD/EUR export receivables; large HVDC and transformer export orders hedged through forward cover
inr_exposure.evidence: Hitachi Energy India FY2025 revenue: ₹6,442.1 Cr (+23% YoY). Export orders ~30% of total (Q2FY26 data confirms 30.4%). Export customers include European utilities, SE Asia data centres, Middle East renewables. Record HVDC and transformer orders in FY2025.

china_plus_one.evidence: Lupin is India's 3rd largest pharma company in the US prescription generic market. India-manufactured APIs and finished dosage forms are positioned as reliable alternatives to Chinese pharma supply, consistent with China+1 trends. Other Developed Markets grew 23.4% in FY2025 — indicating demand for Indian alternatives. However, explicit 'China+1' framing not found in FY2025 press releases; growth is driven by US specialty generics (complex generics, inhalers, biosimilars) rather than supply-chain-substitution narrative.

crude_exposure.evidence: Lupin uses petroleum-derived solvents and organic chemical intermediates in API and finished formulation synthesis. Estimated ~20% of raw material cost is crude oil-linked (solvents, chemical intermediates from petrochemical chain). India formulations FY2025: ₹75,773 Mn; Global APIs: ₹11,772 Mn.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts and options; ~50-60% of near-term USD receivables hedged (standard policy for major Indian pharma exporters)
inr_exposure.evidence: Lupin FY2025 revenue mix: India 34% (₹75,773 Mn formulations, +13.8%), US 38% (~US$980Mn full year, +20%), Other Developed Markets 11% (₹25,072 Mn, +23.4%), Growth Markets 9% (₹25,354 Mn, +6.8%), APIs 5% (₹11,772 Mn, +3.1%). Total consolidated revenue ~₹22,300 Cr. Export (non-India) revenue: ~66%.

pli_scheme.evidence: Lupin Limited is a beneficiary of the Government of India's PLI scheme for Pharmaceuticals (bulk drugs and formulations). The company's API manufacturing capabilities in India are covered under PLI for bulk drug parks and key starting materials.

china_plus_one.evidence: KSB Limited exports pumps and valves with exports at ~17% of order intake. Key export orders include Hassi Massoud Refinery Project in Algeria and UAE water segment orders (KSB Pumps Arabia). KSB India is part of KSB SE & Co. KGaA (Germany). Some supply-chain role in the global KSB group, consistent with modest India manufacturing export growth. No explicit China+1 narrative in available FY2025 data.

govt_capex.evidence: KSB India received solar pump orders worth ₹58 Cr from Departments of Horticulture (Rajasthan), Maharashtra State Electricity, Maharashtra Energy, MPUVNL, and DGVCL. Water management, power generation, and government infrastructure are key end-markets. Estimated ~30% of revenue from government/PSU capex projects based on disclosed order wins.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts on export receivables; KSB India follows KSB Group treasury guidelines
inr_exposure.evidence: KSB Limited FY2025 total sales: ₹2,696 Cr (+6.42% YoY). Net profit: ₹264.5 Cr (+9.8%). Exports ~17% of total order intake (USD/EUR-denominated for Algeria, UAE, and other international orders). EBITDA margin: 16.5% in Q4FY25. Board recommended 220% dividend.
